files.legend.sop:
@legend.calc.arith core.legend
    namespace=calc.arith
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    doc="Arithmetic over numbers with the catalog's words of arithmetic (K4) and the library's core.calc builtins. No state."
files.lexicon.sop:
# GENERATED by scripts/build-calc-world.mjs from the catalog world w.lang.en (shard arithmetic, K4) (catalog index 13fb7b920063). Never edited by hand.

@lex.calc.arith.infix core.lexicon
    class=noun
    doc="Arithmetic operators said between two numbers (\"3 plus 4\"): the w.lang.en.calc words of kind operator, form infix."
    word=added_to
    word=and
    word=divided_by
    word=less
    word=minus
    word=multiplied_by
    word=plus
    word=take_away
    word=times

@lex.calc.arith.prefix core.lexicon
    class=noun
    doc="Arithmetic operators said before one number, with a factor (\"double 6\", \"half of 10\"): kind operator, form prefix."
    word=a_quarter_of
    word=double
    word=half
    word=half_of
    word=triple
    word=twice

@lex.calc.arith.split core.lexicon
    class=noun
    doc="Arithmetic verbs said around two numbers with a marker (\"share 12 between 3\", \"subtract 4 from 10\"): kind operator, form split."
    word=add
    word=divide
    word=multiply
    word=share
    word=split
    word=subtract
files.operations.sop:
@op.calc.arith.compute core.operation
    impl=compute
    semantics=action
    action=calc.compute
    doc="An operation over numbers: an infix word between two numbers, a prefix word with a factor before one, a split verb around two (its marker \"from\" names the second number first); the word's core.calc builtin computes it; dividing by zero is refused."
files.patterns.sop:
# GENERATED by scripts/build-calc-world.mjs from the catalog world w.lang.en (shard arithmetic, K4, catalog index 13fb7b920063). Never edited by hand.

@pat.calc.arith.infix core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.filler]? [what_is|whats|what_are|how_much_is|calculate|work_out|tell_me|what_do|what_does|can_you_tell_me|do_you_know]? {number:number} {op:lex.calc.arith.infix} {other:number} [make|makes|equal|equals|give|come_to|is]? [$lang.tail.filler|please]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=calc.compute arg.form=\"infix\" arg.number=\"{number}\" arg.op=\"{op}\" arg.other=\"{other}\" arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=question
    priority=11
    example="What is 3 plus 4?"

@pat.calc.arith.prefix core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.filler]? [what_is|whats|what_are|how_much_is|calculate|work_out|tell_me|what_do|what_does|can_you_tell_me|do_you_know]? {op:lex.calc.arith.prefix} {number:number} [$lang.tail.filler|please]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=calc.compute arg.form=\"prefix\" arg.op=\"{op}\" arg.number=\"{number}\" arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=question
    priority=11
    example="What is double 6?"
    canonical="What is a quarter of 12?"

@pat.calc.arith.split core.pattern
    match="[$lang.lead.filler]? [$lang.lead.polite]? {op:lex.calc.arith.split} {number:number} {thing:words(3)?} [among|and|between|by|from|into|to] {other:number} {among:words(2)?} [$lang.tail.filler|please]?"
    emit="@{_} core.request action=calc.compute arg.form=\"split\" arg.op=\"{op}\" arg.number=\"{number}\" arg.thing=\"{thing}\" arg.other=\"{other}\" arg.among=\"{among}\" arg.text=\"{segment}\""
    kind=question
    priority=11
    example="Share 12 between 3."
files.templates.sop:
@tpl.calc.arith.compute core.template
    for=action.calc.compute
    text="{value}"

@tpl.calc.arith.compute.conflicting core.template
    for=action.calc.compute
    status=conflicting
    text="{note}"
